note: King, front view. Head is the crown, hair, ears and full beard, bottom y~460 at the beard tip (sides ~y430); the collar, gold-trimmed blue robe, medallion, belt and the cape tip at the right are torso. The robe has wide bell sleeves with a gold trim at the end of each: the art marks no elbow, so it is halfway on the sleeve (left y558, right y566); the sleeve with its gold cuff is forearm down to the diagonal cuff edge, and the bare fists below it are the hands (left x278-368 y~600-700, right x645-742 y~612-720). Under the long robe the hip is the hem y~868 and the covered thighs and lower legs get no label; only the sock tops showing between hem and shoes (y868-895) are lower leg, and the shoes from y895 are feet.
